review.verdict: Three boss deaths and bottom-half damage
review.summary: Died on Gothik (Spectral Horse, 3:10), the Horsemen (a Mark at 1:54) and Kel'Thuzad (Frost Blast, 2:21), plus three trash deaths. Eleventh on Faerlina was your best; most bosses were 13th to 22nd. 166 Sunders and two Meteor soaks.

fix.title: Horsemen
fix.text: A Mark killed you at 1:54: 5.5k in one tick. Move before your marks stack that high.

fix.title: Gothik
fix.text: Died at 3:10 to a Spectral Horse (8k).

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: 3.5 per pull against a warrior median of 4.3, no Giants.

review.verdict: Most healing on Patchwerk, 33 dispels
review.summary: First of the healers on Patchwerk (593/s) and Loatheb. 33 dispels, including Thunderclaps and Frost Novas on trash. Frost Blast killed you on Kel'Thuzad at 2:21, and Hjärterkung brought you back.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Frost Blast at 2:21. Last of the healers there at 186/s even before that.

fix.title: Sapphiron
fix.text: 11th of 12 healers on the kill.

review.verdict: Top healer on four bosses, which only makes the rest of the night harder to explain
review.summary: Credit where it's due, once: first of the healers on Anub'Rekhan, Grobbulus, the Horsemen and Noth, 845 HPS on Sapphiron, 22 Fear Wards. Now the rest. On Patchwerk, the one boss where healing is the whole fight, you were 12th of 12 at 116 HPS with 87% overheal: you spent two minutes topping up people who were already full. You died twice on trash, the second time needing Etowa's Rebirth to get off the floor. Kel'Thuzad mind-controlled you, so for a while you were on his team, which, given Patchwerk, may have been a fair trade for us. 22 Mana Potions to get through the night, the most of any healer, and Spirit of Zanza on 2 pulls out of 15.

good.title: Healing
good.text: First on Anub'Rekhan, Grobbulus, the Four Horsemen and Noth. Annoyingly good.

good.title: Sapphiron
good.text: 845 HPS on the kill, second of the healers.

good.title: Fear Ward
good.text: 22 casts. The one job you did all night without a footnote.

fix.title: Patchwerk
fix.text: Last of twelve healers at 116 HPS, 87% overheal. Patchwerk is a healing check and you sat it out with full mana bars on full health bars.

fix.title: Standing in things
fix.text: Two Rain of Fire hits on Faerlina, Web Wrapped on Maexxna, four Chain Lightnings on Thaddius. For a healer who is supposed to stand still at the back, you found a lot of things to stand in.

fix.title: Trash
fix.text: Two trash deaths, and the second one cost Etowa a Rebirth.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Mind-controlled. Briefly the most useful you were to the boss all night.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Spirit of Zanza on 2 of 15 pulls, then 22 Mana Potions to make up for it.

51118.text: Last of the healers, 116 HPS, 87% overheal.

review.verdict: Main tank on ten bosses; the Sapphiron wipe started with your death at 0:03
review.summary: Tanked Anub'Rekhan, Faerlina, Maexxna, Patchwerk, Grobbulus, Gluth, Noth, Heigan, Loatheb and Kel'Thuzad, and held them all. On the first Sapphiron pull you went from 77% to dead in three seconds, with 2.5k healing on you in that time; that's a healing problem more than a tanking one. 153 Sunders, 23 Demoralizing Shouts, 7 Greater Stoneshields.

good.title: Main tank
good.text: Ten bosses tanked, no boss deaths on kills.

good.title: Gluth
good.text: Held him, one Mortal Wound stack noted.

good.title: Prepared
good.text: 7 Greater Stoneshields and 5.7 consumables per pull, on the tank median.

fix.title: Sapphiron pull 1
fix.text: Dead at 0:03 with 2.5k healing received against 15k of melee. Make sure the tank healers are ready before you pull.

fix.title: Grobbulus
fix.text: Two Slime Sprays on you.

review.verdict: Third on Faerlina, Thaddius and Heigan, four Frostbolts kicked
review.summary: Third on Faerlina, Thaddius (2575/s) and Heigan, top five on Maexxna, Patchwerk, Grobbulus, Noth and Loatheb. Tanked on Gothik. 6 interrupts, 4 of them Kel'Thuzad's Frostbolts, and 173 Sunders. One boss death: Kel'Thuzad at 2:24, to a Frostbolt.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Died at 2:24 to a Frostbolt, one of five deaths in four seconds there.

good.title: Sapphiron
good.text: 9 Life Drains removed on the kill.

fix.title: Faerlina
fix.text: 25 DPS on a 52-second fight, alive the whole time. If you were doing something else there, tell the officers; if not, that's a full fight lost.

fix.title: Gothik
fix.text: Dead at 1:22 to a Deathknight's Shadow Mark and melee.

fix.text: Bottom five on Gluth, Heigan, Thaddius, Grobbulus and Sapphiron.

review.verdict: Top-3 damage on seven bosses, 11 interrupts and no boss deaths
review.summary: First on Faerlina (2137/s) and Noth (1529/s), second on the Four Horsemen and Sapphiron, third on Maexxna, Grobbulus, Gothik and Kel'Thuzad. 11 interrupts: 5 Shadow Bolt Volleys on Gothik's side and trash, 4 of Kel'Thuzad's Frostbolts and 2 Slime Bolts. Not a single boss death.

good.title: Damage
good.text: Top three on Faerlina, Maexxna, Grobbulus, Gothik, the Horsemen, Noth, Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad.

good.title: Interrupts
good.text: 11, second in the raid. 4 of the 21 interrupted Frostbolts on Kel'Thuzad.

fix.title: Flask
fix.text: Flask of the Titans on 6 of 15 pulls. You were top three anyway; the flask is for the nights when it's close.

review.summary: First death of the night: the spider trash before Anub'Rekhan, by a Skitterer, in melee, as a mage. Then dead again to the next pack of Necro Stalkers, then twice more in the trash wipes. On the bosses you were 15th to 21st on most of them, Gothik (second) being the one exception, and Sapphiron's Frost Aura got you at 0:29 on the wipe. The redemption arc: 50 dispels and 20 Life Drains removed, the most in the raid.

good.title: Life Drains
good.text: 20 removed, the most in the raid, 15 of them on the kill.

good.title: Gothik
good.text: Second on damage, 331/s. The one boss where you showed up.

fix.title: Damage
fix.text: 21st on Maexxna and Noth, 20th on Gluth, 19th on Grobbulus, 25th on Sapphiron. Behind most of the warriors, a hunter or two and, on Noth, a tank.

fix.title: Trash
fix.text: Four trash deaths, including the first of the night. Melee'd to death by a spider. A mage.

fix.title: Sapphiron pull 1
fix.text: Frost Aura at 0:29.

51119.text: 15 Life Drains removed on the kill.

review.verdict: Top ten on most bosses, 17 Mighty Rage Potions
review.summary: Second on Grobbulus, sixth on Anub'Rekhan, Thaddius, Gothik, the Horsemen and Heigan. 17 Mighty Rage Potions and 10 Sappers. One boss death: Kel'Thuzad at 2:24, to a Frostbolt.

fix.title: Healing
fix.text: 12th of 12 on Anub'Rekhan, 11th on Faerlina, Heigan and Kel'Thuzad, with 80-88% overheal early on.

fix.text: Two Rain of Fire hits on Faerlina, and the blizzard killed you on the Sapphiron wipe.

51119.text: Died in the blizzard on the wipe.

review.verdict: The raid's dispeller: 77 dispels, the most by 18
review.summary: 77 dispels, ahead of Osinir and Sixto (59 each): 49 Veils of Shadow, 11 Life Drains, 8 Curses of the Plaguebringer and 8 Veils of Darkness. You brought Apoutchou back with Rebirth, kept Faerie Fire up (256 casts) and handed out 10 Innervates. Second-highest healing on Gluth (343/s). No boss deaths.

good.title: Dispels
good.text: 77, the most in the raid. Every kind of curse and drain the night threw at you.

good.title: Sapphiron
good.text: 10 Life Drains removed on the kill.

good.title: Noth
good.text: 5 Curses of the Plaguebringer removed, tied for second.

good.title: Utility

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: 2.1 consumable buffs per pull against a healer median of 3.5, and no world buffs at all on your first boss snapshot. Not costing much tonight, but it's the easiest gain on the list.

51119.text: 10 Life Drains removed on the kill.

review.summary: Second on Gluth (1439/s), third on Noth, fourth on Heigan. 190 Sunders. On Kel'Thuzad a Shadow Fissure killed you at 0:16, the first death of the fight (143k Void Blast), so you did 38 DPS there. Thaddius and Patchwerk were low.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Dead at 0:16 in a Shadow Fissure. Step out of a fissure the moment it appears under you.

fix.title: Patchwerk and Thaddius
fix.text: 18th and 17th.

review.verdict: Most damage on Anub'Rekhan, and Mr. Bigglesworth's killer

review.summary: Soaked 15 Hateful Strikes on Patchwerk next to Macharius, and tanked Anub'Rekhan, Grobbulus, Razuvious, Gothik and the Horsemen. 95 Demoralizing Shouts (the most by far) and 191 Sunders. No boss deaths.

51119.text: Died at 0:06 on the wipe, little healing.

fix.text: One Void Zone hit.

review.verdict: 36 Hateful Strikes on Patchwerk, and no boss deaths
review.summary: You soaked 36 of the 51 Hateful Strikes on Patchwerk and nobody died. Tanked Thaddius (the record kill), Razuvious, the Horsemen, Noth and Kel'Thuzad, and didn't die on a boss all night. 168 Sunders and two Greater Stoneshields.

fix.text: Died at 2:24, one of five in four seconds.

good.title: Divine Intervention
good.text: Used during the trash wipe after Gothik.

fix.title: Anub'Rekhan and Faerlina
fix.text: One Impale and one Rain of Fire hit.

review.verdict: Most healing on three bosses, two Understudies and 22 Power Infusions
review.summary: First of the healers on Maexxna, Gluth and Thaddius, third on Sapphiron (841/s) and Kel'Thuzad. Controlled two Understudies on Razuvious, cast 22 Power Infusions and 7 Shackles. No boss deaths.

good.title: Healing

fix.title: Gothik

good.title: Sapphiron
good.text: 15 Life Drains removed on the kill.

fix.text: 25th on Grobbulus, 24th on Anub'Rekhan and Sapphiron, 23rd on Thaddius, Noth and Loatheb.

review.summary: Second of the healers on Heigan, 19 dispels including 4 Poison Bolt Volleys on Faerlina. fix.text: Last of the healers on Thaddius, Gothik and Sapphiron.

fix.text: Mana Detonation from Utzemekanism at 1:13. It's on the mage to run, but stay spread out on Kel'Thuzad.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Dead at 0:59 in a Shadow Fissure. Step out of a fissure the moment it appears under you.

review.verdict: Most healing on Heigan, Divine Intervention in the trash wipe

fix.title: Anub'Rekhan

review.verdict: Three boss deaths and the bottom third on damage
review.summary: Died on the Horsemen (Mograine's melee and Righteous Fire at 1:46), on the Sapphiron wipe and on Kel'Thuzad at 2:24. On damage, 24th on Noth, 23rd on Kel'Thuzad, 20th on Gothik. Two Meteor soaks and an interrupt on Kel'Thuzad.

fix.title: Horsemen
fix.text: Dead at 1:46 to Mograine's melee and Righteous Fire, 62% to 0 in seven seconds. If you weren't meant to be at Mograine, don't be.

fix.text: Died at 2:24.

fix.title: Gluth and Noth
fix.text: Almost no healing on Gluth (26/s) and Noth (41/s, 93% overheal). If you were on other duties, fine; if not, those were free throughput.

review.summary: First on Patchwerk (1791/s, 217k) and Thaddius (2998/s, 417k), third on Gluth. 337 Curses of Recklessness and 2 Soulstones. One boss death: Kel'Thuzad at 2:24, with his melee and a Frostbolt on you. Loatheb was the weak spot, last of the damage dealers at 470/s.

good.title: Thaddius
good.text: 2998 DPS, the most in the raid on the guild's record kill.

fix.title: Loatheb
fix.text: 26th of 26 at 470/s, after first place on Patchwerk and Thaddius. Worth checking what went wrong there.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Died at 2:24 with Kel'Thuzad hitting you in melee (7k) and a Frostbolt on top.

review.verdict: Curse of the Elements all night, three Soulstones
review.summary: 314 Curses of the Elements and 3 Soulstones. Tenth on Kel'Thuzad. No boss deaths. Damage was low on Maexxna (last), Heigan and Sapphiron.

fix.text: Last of the damage dealers on both (262/s and 234/s), and 26th on Heigan.

review.verdict: Tranquilizing Shots on Gluth, Hunter's Mark on every boss
review.summary: 3 Tranquilizing Shots on Gluth, 14 Hunter's Marks and 3 poisons cleansed. Damage around your usual for a hunter here. On the Sapphiron wipe his Cleave killed you at 0:18.

fix.title: Faerlina

fix.text: Killed by Cleave at 0:18. Sapphiron was loose after both tanks died, so this one is mostly on the pull.

review.verdict: Top-five damage on six bosses, and three boss deaths
review.summary: Second on Faerlina and Patchwerk, fourth on Thaddius, fifth on Anub'Rekhan and Kel'Thuzad. 20 Stratholme Holy Waters. But three boss deaths: one Razuvious hit at 1:02 (23k), a Void Zone on the Horsemen at 3:37 and Sapphiron's Cleave on the wipe.

fix.text: One melee hit from Razuvious for 23k at 1:02. Being anywhere he can swing at is a death.

review.verdict: Most damage on Grobbulus, Razuvious and Heigan, and tanked a Horseman
review.summary: First on Grobbulus (1499/s), Razuvious (1125/s) and Heigan (1427/s), second on Anub'Rekhan and Kel'Thuzad. Tanked on the Four Horsemen. 7 interrupts, 4 of them Kel'Thuzad's Frostbolts. One boss death: Gothik, to a Spectral Horse at 3:21.

good.title: Damage
good.text: First on three bosses, second on two.

fix.title: Gothik
fix.text: Died at 3:21 to a Spectral Horse, ten seconds after Alanakos died to one. 8k from the Horse and 5.7k from the Rider in your last seconds.

51109.text: Died at 3:21 to a Spectral Horse.

review.summary: First on Gluth (1449/s), the Four Horsemen (575/s) and Kel'Thuzad (1020/s), second on Thaddius, Noth and Loatheb. No boss deaths. Heigan was the outlier at 23rd of 27.

fix.text: 23rd of 27 at 528/s, half your usual pace. Heigan can teleport people off the boss, so it may not be on you.

review.verdict: The top healer: first or second on ten bosses
review.summary: Most healing on Faerlina (643/s, 19% of the raid's), Gothik and Kel'Thuzad (550/s), second on Anub'Rekhan, Maexxna, Patchwerk, the Horsemen and Noth. 7 Decrepit Fevers cured on Heigan and 2 Shackles on Kel'Thuzad. No boss deaths.
